Medford/Tufts large first floor 2 bedroom/1 bath rental apartment. Full use of the driveway for three vehicles, a private rear outdoor space, and gas, electricity, water/sewer included in the rent price. Tenants only pay for cable/wifi. The unit is located on Benton Rd in Medford and just steps to Tufts University, and also very close to Ball Sq, Magoun Sq, Davis Sq in Somerville, Assembly Row I93, and the Green and Red line train stations. 

Unit features include a large living area, spacious dining area, eat in-kitchen, modern bath, and two good sized bedrooms with ample closet space. Additionally there is deeded basement storage along with a private washer/dryer, rear enclosed porch, and a back patio. No pets and no undergrad students. A lease can begin anytime between 11/1 and 12/1. 

Please contact Ben Carroll with any questions or to arrange a viewing!
